sloka: श्रूयते हि पुरा सौम्य कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः ।पुत्रो बाह्लीश्वरः श्रीमानिलो नाम महाशयाः ।। ७.८७.३ ॥
transliteration: śrūyate hi purā saumya kardamasya prajāpateḥ ।putro bāhlīśvaraḥ śrīmānilo nāma mahāśayāḥ ।। 7.87.3 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, it is indeed heard that formerly, there was a glorious son of Prajapati Kardama, named Ila, who was the lord of Bahlika and of great mind.
